title: Generated-Artifact Registry — one fact, one owner, many derived views
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH. This register declares generated-artifact identity and lifecycle. It is upstream of every engine it describes and must never be produced by one of them.
why_this_exists: The same fact — 'this path is generated output' — was expressed in three independent places:
for registration eligibility, and .gitignore prose for the version-control boundary. They drifted,
and the drift was not hypothetical: UCOS-RECON-C2 records the eleven RIE outputs being admitted to
the Repository Corpus and given permanent identities because EXCLUDE_DIR_PREFIXES enumerated
generated outputs only where they lived under 00-BOOK/. `intelligence/` did not exist when that list
was written — verbatim the RECON-C1 root cause, one leg later.
Two producers declared nothing at all. UCOS-AEE-001 and UAIE-000001 emit 18 and 12 tracked files
respectively and carry no `outputs` section, so no declaration named them as generated; RIB
maintained a hard-coded understanding of only its own.
This register is the single upstream fact. Derived views consume it; none produces it. Adding a
generated artifact is now ONE entry here rather than edits to several independent lists.

input_classifications.TRACKED_DETERMINISTIC: Version-controlled input. Same commit implies same bytes.
input_classifications.ENVIRONMENTAL: Depends on the execution environment (test runner, wall clock, machine). Absent from a pristine clone.
input_classifications.OPERATIONAL: Per-clone operational state of a tool or runtime.
input_classifications.UNKNOWN: Unclassified. FAILS CLOSED — a canonical artifact may not depend on an input nobody has classified.
input_classifications.EXECUTION_TRANSCRIPT: Captured stdout/stderr of a command run. A historical observation of one execution event, not repository truth. UAKOS-CLOSURE-008.
input_classifications.LOCAL_RUNTIME: Per-clone runtime or machine state observed during a run (paths, interpreter, venv, host).
input_classifications.ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION: A measurement of the execution environment (timings, coverage totals, counts as observed).

invariants: Every canonical_path resolves to exactly one producer.
No two entries claim the same canonical_path.
Every entry carries a producer, an owner, a lifecycle and a non-empty input_closure.
Every input in every input_closure carries a classification.
An entry with any UNKNOWN input classification fails closed.
A deterministic:true entry may not declare an ENVIRONMENTAL input — this is the structural bar that makes the UCOS-CL-005 coverage defect unrepresentable rather than merely fixed.
RIB's own generated-path view equals the registry-derived view for UCOS-RIB-001.

CANONICAL_ARTIFACT_INPUT_CLASSIFICATION — a CANONICAL artifact may not declare an EXECUTION_TRANSCRIPT, LOCAL_RUNTIME or ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION input. An execution transcript is preserved and referenced by id; it never enters canonical identity. The escape is to declare the artifact NON_CANONICAL — evidence rather than identity. UAKOS-CLOSURE-008.
Every canonical_identity_role is one of CANONICAL, NON_CANONICAL or EXCLUDED.

environmental_artifacts.note: Declared here so the exclusion is VISIBLE rather than implicit. Any canonical entry naming this path in its input_closure fails the deterministic/environmental invariant, which is what makes the UCOS-CL-005 leak structurally unrepresentable rather than merely removed once.
